text: Regenerate protos with `buf generate` from the repo root, never hand-edit gen/. CI runs `buf breaking --against '.git#branch=main'`, so renumbering or retyping a field in delivery.proto fails the build; add new fields with new numbers.
Retries are just Kafka redelivery: on failure we don't commit the offset and the consumer reads the message again.

Failed deliveries are written to delivery_attempts with next_attempt_at and the retry worker polls that table. Commit the Kafka offset as soon as the attempt row is saved, otherwise one bad endpoint blocks the whole partition.
Anything in internal/delivery that calls time.Now() directly makes tests flaky. Take a clockx.Clock in the constructor and use clockx.NewFake() in tests, then fake.Add(d) to move time forward.
Jitter has to be computed per attempt, not once per process. After the March outage every webhook for one tenant retried in the same second and their side fell over again.
Max delivery attempts is a const in worker.go (maxAttempts = 5).
Attempt limit comes from RetryPolicy on the request now, falling back to config.Delivery.MaxAttempts (default 8). The maxAttempts const in worker.go is gone.
delivery_attempts has a partial index on next_attempt_at WHERE status = 'pending'. A poll query without the status filter seq-scans ~40M rows; check EXPLAIN before merging any change to the poll SQL.
Migrations are goose files in migrations/ with a 4-digit prefix. `make migrate-up` locally. Never edit a migration that is already on main, add a new one.
Tests: `go test ./... -race -count=1`. Integration tests need `-tags=integration` and `docker compose up -d postgres redpanda` first.
Public REST gateway rate limit (internal/gateway/ratelimit.go) is a token bucket per API key; burst and refill live in config.Gateway.
Admin dashboard templates in web/admin use html/template. Tenant display names are user input, never pass them through template.HTML (XSS report in March).
Local Kafka is the confluent image in docker-compose.yml, topic auto-create is on so you don't need to create topics.
Local broker is Redpanda (`docker compose up -d redpanda`). Auto-create is off, run `make topics` once after a fresh volume or the consumer crashes with UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PARTITION.
Field 7 in tenant.proto is reserved after the i18n rollback (it was locale). Don't reuse 7.
Commit style: `area: lowercase summary` (e.g. `store: ...`). Squash merge only.
Dead-letter topic is relaybox.delivery.dlq. Anything moved there needs last_error and attempt_count set, the replay tool (cmd/dlqreplay) skips messages without last_error.

Webhook signature is HMAC-SHA256 over `timestamp + "." + body`, sent as X-Relaybox-Signature. Per-endpoint secret comes from vault path secret/relaybox/endpoints/<id> (locally: FAKE_SIGNING_SECRET in .env).
golangci-lint local pe chalana ho toh `make lint` use karo. Direct golangci-lint run karoge toh version mismatch aata hai aur .golangci.yml ke rules alag behave karte hain.
Config hot reload (config/watch.go) only re-reads log level and feature flags. Changing the DB DSN or Kafka brokers still needs a restart.
Deploy: tag vX.Y.Z on main, the release workflow pushes the image and ArgoCD picks it up. Staging auto-syncs, prod needs a manual sync in Argo.
pprof is on :6060 only with RELAYBOX_DEBUG=1. Last heap profile showed the admin UI template cache as the top allocator, fixed by parsing templates once at startup.
grafana/relaybox.json mein panel IDs change mat karna, alerts unhi IDs pe bane hain. Naya panel add karo toh naya id do.

Retryable vs permanent: endpoint 4xx (except 408 and 429) is permanent, return codes.FailedPrecondition and don't schedule a retry. 5xx, timeouts and connection resets are retryable (codes.Unavailable).
